name: Subset Teaching Dimension / Balbach Teaching Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal upper bound in terms of the other, even up to an affine-linear factor.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For every $u\ge3$, the family $\mathcal C^u_{1/2}=\{\{x_i\}:i\in[u+1]\}\cup\{\{x_i,x_j\}:i,j\in[u+1]\}$ has $\mathrm{STD}=u$ and $\mathrm{BTD}=3$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For every $u$, the paired family $\mathcal C^u_{\mathrm{pair}}$ of Theorem 18 has $\mathrm{STD}=1$ and $\mathrm{BTD}=u$.
proof: The two assertions of Theorem 18 give the respective directional unbounded separations.
